correctness.rationale: For p≥5, CRT classes A_t=(1,g^t) and B_t=(2,cg^t) with c≠1,g alternate. Both classes cover their units once, and differences become (2,(1−c)g^t) and (1,(c−g)g^t), enumerating every unit. For odd q|m, the lift y_(rL+i)=x_i+mr α_i, α_i alternating 1,2, includes all q vertex lifts. Every ordinary edge difference varies with nonzero slope ±1 mod q, and the wrap edge varies with slope 1 because φ(m)=L is even. Thus all q lifts of each prior difference occur exactly once and induction covers every exponent. Independently constructed and fully verified cycles for p=5,7,11,13 and successive q=3,3,p, including the wrap.
residual_risks: Independent checks cover finitely many base primes/exponents; unrestricted proof uses the explicit algebraic CRT and slope identities.
